mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_execution_evaluation (id, task_id, project_id, executor_type, executor_id, operational_status, business_verdict, completion_rate, evidence_rate, healing_count, retry_count, duration_ms, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{executorType}, #{executorId}, #{operationalStatus}, #{businessVerdict}, #{completionRate}, #{evidenceRate}, #{healingCount}, #{retryCount}, #{durationMs}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE operational_status=VALUES(operational_status), business_verdict=VALUES(business_verdict), completion_rate=VALUES(completion_rate), evidence_rate=VALUES(evidence_rate), healing_count=VALUES(healing_count), retry_count=VALUES(retry_count), duration_ms=VALUES(duration_ms), updated_at=VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.select: SELECT executor_type AS executorType, executor_id AS executorId, COUNT(*) AS sampleCount, SUM(operational_status='SUCCESS') AS successfulRuns, SUM(business_verdict='PRODUCT_FAILED') AS productFailures, SUM(business_verdict='ENV_FAILED') AS environmentFailures, SUM(business_verdict='DATA_FAILED') AS dataFailures, SUM(business_verdict='AGENT_FAILED') AS agentFailures, SUM(business_verdict='BLOCKED') AS blockedRuns, AVG(completion_rate) AS averageCompletionRate, AVG(evidence_rate) AS averageEvidenceRate, AVG(duration_ms) AS averageDurationMs, AVG(manual_score) AS averageManualScore FROM ai_execution_evaluation WHERE project_id=#{projectId} AND created_at >= #{fromTime} AND created_at <= #{toTime} GROUP BY executor_type, executor_id ORDER BY sampleCount DESC, executor_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_execution_evaluation_history (id, task_id, project_id, score, comment, evaluated_by, evaluated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{score}, #{comment}, #{evaluatedBy}, #{evaluatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.id FROM ai_execution_task t LEFT JOIN ai_execution_evaluation e ON e.task_id=t.id WHERE e.id IS NULL AND t.status IN ('SUCCESS','PARTIAL_SUCCESS','FAILED','CANCELED','EXPIRED') ORDER BY t.update_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
